description: A company commander must publish Wednesday's roster for a vehicle-dispatch desk, assigning four available personnel to the day, swing, and night shifts or to the reserve position, while recording the coordination actions needed before the roster takes effect.

shared_context.S1: The Wednesday vehicle-dispatch desk requires one person for each of three shifts: day from 0600 to 1400, swing from 1400 to 2200, and night from 2200 to 0600; one additional person will remain in reserve.
shared_context.S2: The four available personnel for this roster are SPC Hale, CPL Morris, SGT Ibarra, and PFC Cole.
shared_context.S3: Capt. Morgan signs the final roster, and the selected reserve may be called in if a scheduled desk operator becomes unavailable.
shared_context.S4: The company conducts its routine pre-roster coordination huddle with operations, the motor pool, and the battalion liaison before each next-day desk roster is signed.
shared_context.S5: The dispatch desk requires a qualified operator at every shift, and the roster is posted to the company operations board after signature.
shared_context.S6: The reserve position is separate from all three shift positions; one person may occupy only one roster position and cannot be assigned to a shift and reserve at the same time.
shared_context.S7: As a routine huddle practice, once operations, motor pool, and battalion liaison have reported and the commander has restated the proposed assignments, the commander closes the huddle and records the roster rather than continuing another round of discussion.
shared_context.S8: PFC Cole's dispatch qualification is current for the 1400-2200 swing shift, so no additional qualification verification is required before Wednesday's roster is signed.

PF1.text: SPC Hale's current dispatch qualification is valid only for the 2200-0600 night shift; 1LT Shah confirmed the qualification status with the training clerk this morning, but the updated qualification roster has not yet reached Capt. Morgan.

PF2.text: CPL Morris is unavailable for all Wednesday desk duty because a motor-pool occupational-health appointment followed by a 24-hour work restriction was confirmed today; SFC Alvarez received the appointment confirmation from the clinic, but the restriction is not yet reflected on the duty roster.

PF3.text: Battalion headquarters directed SGT Ibarra to remain on the 0600-1400 day shift Wednesday to handle a scheduled liaison handoff; 1LT Becker received the signed tasking message this afternoon, but it has not yet been posted to the company order board.

acceptance_conditions: SPC Hale must be assigned to the night shift because that is the only shift covered by the current qualification.
SGT Ibarra must be assigned to the day shift because of the battalion liaison handoff.
CPL Morris must not be assigned to the reserve because the Wednesday work restriction makes him unavailable for all duty.
The reserve position must be recorded as unfilled and escalated to battalion for an additional qualified operator.
PFC Cole must be assigned to the swing shift.
The three shift positions must contain three different personnel, with no person assigned to both a shift and the reserve position.
The battalion tasking for SGT Ibarra must be cited in the commander's justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'escalation' and c['target'] == 'battalion' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['day_shift_person'] != decisions['swing_shift_person'] and decisions['day_shift_person'] != decisions['night_shift_person'] and decisions['swing_shift_person'] != decisions['night_shift_person']

decisive_facts.why: The qualification restriction changes SPC Hale's assignment from any available desk position to specifically the 2200-0600 night shift.
The 24-hour work restriction changes the reserve assignment from CPL Morris to the exact value UNFILLED and requires an escalation commitment targeting battalion.
The battalion tasking changes SGT Ibarra's assignment to the 0600-1400 day shift and supplies the fact that must be cited by the commander.
